title: Implement memory decay and pruning
description:
Create chatbot/consolidation/decay.py.

Implement a MemoryDecayEngine class that applies decay and pruning to memory:
- Accept a list of MemoryEntry records and return a pruned list with stale entries removed.
- Define configurable decay parameters: base_half_life_seconds (default: 7 days), access_count_weight (how much recent access extends lifetime), relevance_threshold (below which entries are pruned).
- Compute a decay score for each entry based on: age (exponential decay with half-life), access frequency (recent accesses slow decay), and intrinsic relevance (from MemoryEntry metadata).
- Entries whose decay score falls below relevance_threshold are removed from the returned list.
- The decay computation must be deterministic and idempotent: given the same entries, timestamps, and access counts, the same entries are always pruned.
- Handle edge cases: empty input list, all entries below threshold, all entries above threshold, entries with missing timestamps.
- Do NOT call the LLM Provider; this is a purely algorithmic module.
